title: Disaggregated Health Data in LLMs: Evaluating Data Equity in the Context of Asian American Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to generate health issues for 21 specific Asian American sub-ethnic groups and comparing the outputs against a generic 'Asian American' reference group using statistical distance metrics (Kendall-Tau), topic modeling (BERTopic), response diversity measures (ANOVA, Simpson's diversity), and qualitative verification of medical accuracy and critical omissions.
